## Dopad 0.1.3

### Improved
- Completion suggestions now filter and rank against the text before the cursor, with lightweight local keyword suggestions when a language server has no relevant results.
- Completion insertion respects the typed prefix and LSP text-edit ranges, avoiding duplicated prefixes.
- TypeScript and JavaScript language-server installation can use a Dopad-managed Node.js runtime when a compatible system Node.js/npm installation is unavailable.
- Managed runtime downloads are restricted to supported OS/architecture artifacts, verified with pinned SHA-256 digests, and installed under Dopad's app data directory without changing system PATH or project files.
- LSP installation status and actionable failure logs are available through the existing LSP Output view.

### Notes
- Managed npm installation is available for the registered TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON servers. Other language servers retain their existing toolchain requirements.
